turns.user: For a 3DCP mortar with w/b 0.35, s/b 1.5, 90 % OPC + 10 % silica fume and 0.6 % PCE, plot the Bingham flow curve up to 100 1/s and the structuration curve over 45 minutes of rest, and compare both with measured literature curves.
turns.text:
I’ll use the pmpredict models to generate the two curves and retrieve measured literature analogues for comparison, keeping the weak rheology predictions secondary to the published data.
The vocabulary confirms the classes `portland_cement`, `silica_fume`, and `superplasticiser_pce`. I’m now running the flow and rest-time curve tools with the mix marked as 3DCP mortar and requesting measured analogue overlays.
The requested plots are ready, with measured literature curves overlaid.

- [Bingham flow-curve plot](<C:\Users\User\3D Printing Concrete Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013554-a1db\flow_curve_OPC90_SF10_PCE0.6.png>)
- [Structuration-curve plot](<C:\Users\User\3D Printing Concrete Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013554-a1db\structuration_OPC90_SF10_PCE0.6.png>)
- [Flow-curve data CSV](<C:\Users\User\3D Printing Concrete Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013554-a1db\flow_curve_OPC90_SF10_PCE0.6.csv>)
- [Structuration data CSV](<C:\Users\User\3D Printing Concrete Prediction\artifacts\reports\agent\20261017-013554-a1db\structuration_OPC90_SF10_PCE0.6.csv>)

Key modeled results, reported as median [80% interval]:

- Dynamic yield stress: 234 [16, 843] Pa
- Plastic viscosity: 6.43 [0.84, 33.13] Pa·s
- Shear stress at 100 s⁻¹: 1,023 [250, 3,901] Pa
- Initial static yield stress: 271 [22, 9,125] Pa
- Structuration rate, Athix: 0.697 [0.023, 13.669] Pa/s
- Static yield stress after 45 min: 4,003 [307, 61,123] Pa

The flow comparison uses measured mixes M5 and M6 from DOI `10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2021.104158` and M1 from `10.3390/buildings16030490`. The structuration comparison uses measured mixes M2–M4 from `10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105509`.

Defaults applied were natural sand, zero initial rest time, moist curing at 20 °C and 95% RH, age 28 d, and `comp_cube50`; the last three do not materially define these fresh-state curves. No training-range violation was reported. Athix is a weak-model output, so the structuration prediction is order-of-magnitude guidance; the measured overlays should be treated as the primary evidence. Final use requires experimental rheometer verification.
